notes.title: Sayonara Sale
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello Survivors,[/b][/p][p]After years of blood, survival, and unforgettable stories, it’s finally time to say goodbye.
As part of my rebranding and the reboot of my studio, the [i]Red Colony[/i] series, as you know it, will soon be leaving the Steam store.[/p][p]Before that happens, I wanted to give everyone one last chance to experience the series. Starting today, [b][i]Red Colony[/i], [i]Red Colony 2[/i], and [i]Red Colony 3[/i][/b] will be on their [b]final Sayonara Sale[/b]. This is the last opportunity to pick them up before they are retired from Steam.[/p][p]I want to personally thank every single player who has supported me through this journey. Your encouragement and feedback not only kept the series alive but also gave me the strength to take the next step: transforming into a fully self-publishing studio. This is the beginning of a fresh chapter — starting on a clean slate with new ideas, new worlds, and, who knows… maybe even a new vision for [i]Red Colony[/i] someday down the road.[/p][p][b][u]If you’ve been waiting to play, now is the moment.[/u][/b]
Once the sale ends, the series will no longer be available for purchase.[/p][p]Thank you for surviving with me.
This isn’t the end — it’s the start of something new.
[/p][p]With gratitude,
Rune Shimotsuji Storm
Solo Dev & Founder, RunicCodes AB[/p]

notes.title: Red Colony Uncensored Is OUT!
notes.notes:
I'll try my best to be as active as possible in the Red Colony Uncensored Discussions if you have any questions or concerns!

The game support Keyboard but I ticked the box "Does not support keyboard" since I really don't recommend playing with Keyboard. However, here are the controllers for anyone who is interested in playing the game that way:

WASD - MOVE
E - USE
R - Back
Shift - Run
Ctrl - Pull Weapon
Space - Shoot/Slash Knife
Arrows Up/Down - Aim

Good luck out there!
